name: wp-duplicate-param-last-wins
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] The regex-based query parser processes pairs sequentially and later duplicates overwrite earlier ones (last occurrence wins). URLSearchParams.get() used by the engine returns the FIRST occurrence.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruling #11): LAST occurrence wins (plugin + server-parser convention). Original note: duplicate query params -- plugin last-wins, engine first-wins.
